items.title: Kenneth Walker: Ankle injury not serious
items.description:
Walker is experiencing swelling around his ankle but is expected to "be fine," Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.title: Michael Penix: Intends to be ready Week 1
items.description:
Penix (knee) won't play in Friday's preseason game in Miami, but he believes he'll be available for a Week 1 road matchup with the Steelers on Sunday, Sept. 13, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.title: Luther Burden: Back at practice Wednesday
items.description:
Burden (groin) returned to practice Wednesday, but he was contained to individual drills, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Starting preseason Week 3
items.description:
Coach Kevin Stefanski said Wednesday that Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason game at Miami, Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Doing rehab work Wednesday
items.description:
